summary: Frontend-only E2E testing completed for Techin By Raj. Verified landing page sections (Hero, Marquee, Indicator, Method, Courses, Pricing, FAQ), FAQ accordion, signup/login/logout flows, buy flow for both logged-in and non-logged-in states (Stripe redirect verified), and Dashboard rendering with empty-library + Complete-your-setup listings. All 13 test assertions passed.

issues: Locked product cards under 'Complete your setup' show low-contrast description text (dim gray on near-black). Readable but borderline.

critical_code_review_comments: useBuy.js: on checkout error, toast is shown but no auth-modal reopen if 401; consider handling expired-token case explicitly.
Console warning: framer-motion useScroll target container has static position (Hero section). Add position: relative to avoid inaccurate scroll offsets.
Landing.jsx (~420 lines) is close to acceptable but combines many section components; consider splitting into per-section files for maintainability.
seed_data_creation: Created two random test users via signup (test_*@example.com). trader@example.com already existed and logged in successfully.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All critical frontend flows pass. Stripe redirect from indicator-buy-btn and hero-buy-indicator (post-signup auto-continue) works. AuthModal, header signup/login/logout, FAQ accordion, and Dashboard all functional. Only non-blocking framer-motion warning and minor contrast note remain.
